about:
A-Auto Salvage opened its doors in 1990 in Little Rock, Arkansas. The business is family owned and operated, drawing on a combined experience of over 50 years in the automotive industry. The founders, though not named individually, established the salvage yard to serve the local market with used and new auto parts.

The company operates a salvage yard where customers can hand-pick parts from late-model and older vehicles, including cars and trucks that many other suppliers no longer stock. Inventory covers engines, transmissions, tires, batteries, rear ends, and interior pieces for a wide range of makes — from Ford, GM, and Dodge to Honda, Toyota, BMW, and Mercedes-Benz. In addition to parts sales, A-Auto Salvage provides auto repair services such as fuel system work and manufacturer-recommended maintenance. The yard also offers same-day pickup for vehicle purchases and a parts-locating service for hard-to-find items.

The business serves Pulaski, Saline, Garland, Lonoke, and Jefferson counties, supplying both individual vehicle owners and repair shops. Its customer base includes anyone needing affordable replacement parts for domestic and import models, as well as those seeking professional installation and maintenance.

A-Auto Salvage emphasizes hands-on service, competitive pricing, and the assurance that a live person always answers the phone. The company says its reputation rests on expertise and a high customer satisfaction rate, with same-day vehicle pickup and the ability to source obscure parts setting it apart from larger, less personal operations.
